emerging_technology: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a large language model over internal authoritative documents
organization: Fictional mid-sized industrial manufacturer with SAP Ariba and Jira Service Management Cloud
intended_application: Analyst-facing first-pass triage of suspected production IT outages using current runbooks
business_need: Reduce time from an alert to a correct human escalation
users_stakeholders: Service desk, on-call infrastructure team, incident commanders and production teams
capabilities_constraints: Jira Service Management Cloud and approved escalation rules are available. Runbook version consistency, access isolation and Jira AI entitlements are unverified. Historical incidents can be redacted for replay.
risk_consequence_context: Delayed escalation can extend downtime. No end-user or automated remediation. Incident commanders keep severity and dispatch authority.
management_question: Should the service desk change the live routing path, or restrict the technology to shadow-mode incident replay?
additional_context: Synthetic classroom scenario. Service operations manager owns evaluation with the incident commander. Use evidence snapshot dated 2026-11-16.
